summary: Tested G-13 turret AUTO mode and Tone Lock Assist end to end. Backend: turret.auto {switch_m:10,min_conf:55,sweep_hz_per_s:700,min_heat_factor:0.35} and turret.tone_lock {show_from:0.15,lock_at:0.85} are in GET /api/rules, and the PUT round-trip plus restore works. 3 new tests added; 39/39 pass when run serially (-n0). Frontend: AUTO is the default (turret-mode-auto-button active). G/G goes preview -> deploying -> active. The status tag reads 'G-13 ACTIVE · AUTO <hz>Hz'. Deployed at lead 20 (targets 20-32m away), AUTO fired the laser on its own: recorded laser_fire auto:true (results ignition_fail / hit, and kill on a second pulse once P-01 resist dropped below 0.35; P-01 resist went 1 -> 0.7 -> 0.18). auto_switch was logged with reasons range, ignition and cooldown. In AUTO the acoustic cone appears without needing Hold tone, and the tone self-sweeps (948 -> 1356 -> 1400 for pygmies). The Tone Lock ring appears with a -Hz offset label (e.g. -44Hz at 0.72) and shows 'TONE LOCK' with green #00ff9d stroke at >=0.85. Deployed at lead 0, AUTO switches straight to acoustic with reason 'close' and never fires the laser. Manual WOLF-TONE slider: 1400 -> lock 1.00 TONE LOCK, 1300 -> 0.38 '-100Hz', 1100 -> hidden. Manual LASER: no ring, no auto-fire, F fires (auto:false, hit). M cycles AUTO -> LASER -> WOLF-TONE -> AUTO. Hold tone off removes the cone in manual acoustic. Regression OK: recall, hold-T shutdown (DOWN at 2.5s held), modules WIDE/LONG/DECOY (cone and range change), dampen (cue_scale 0.4), record -> sessions -> replay of turret state, visor page unaffected, no console errors. Main problem found: targets get re-picked every 0.5-1s, which makes the AUTO tone hunt between bands.

ui_bugs.issue: No target hysteresis. turret_target changes every ~0.5-1s (P-01 -> P-04 -> P-02 -> W-01 -> ... more than 60 retargets in 45s of a recording) because the rank is e.score, which jitters (pygmies move by sine). AUTO sweeps toward each new target's band at 700Hz/s, so the tone hunts between 1400 and 180/528 and rarely holds a lock on mixed groups. The Tone Lock ring flickers on and off as the target alternates between a pygmy (locked) and G-01 (lock 0), in both AUTO and manual WOLF-TONE.

When the laser is unavailable (cooldown), the acoustic target is still chosen from all contacts within laser range (40m) instead of acoustic range (25m * module). Deployed at lead 20, AUTO targeted G-01 at 32m (out of Wolf-Tone reach) and swept the tone to 528 while the pygmies at 20-24m were in the cone, so they were not hurt and tone_on sometimes dropped to false.

too_fast / abort_speed uses target.approach_mps, which is measured against the player, not the turret. When the player steps closer after deploying, the entity-to-turret distance stays about the same, but approach_mps reads 22 m/s, so AUTO reports too_fast and suppresses the laser by mistake. The score and targeting also use player-relative distance.

integration_issues.issue: EVENT_LABEL in lib/gameEvents.js has no entries for turret events (laser_fire, auto_switch, acoustic_on/off, turret_*). The deck-mark titles for those events are undefined.

issues: tone-lock-label is 8px at 0.7 alpha over a busy corridor image; the -Hz/TONE LOCK text is hard to read. Suggest 10-11px with a dark halo.

action_items: Add target stickiness/hysteresis to turret targeting: keep the current target unless a new one beats it by a margin or the current one is lost or killed, so the AUTO sweep and Tone Lock ring are stable.
In AUTO when effective mode is acoustic, pick the target from contacts inside acoustic range/cone (range_m * mod.range_mult) so the sweep tunes to something the tone can hit.
Compute approach speed relative to the turret (change of s.back + e.distance_m) for the too_fast/abort_speed checks.
Add EVENT_LABEL entries for turret events so replay marks have titles.
critical_code_review_comments: turret.js: in AUTO with no target (autoWhy no_target), mode is still 'acoustic'. toneOn can turn on for any alive entity in the cone, including NEUTRAL gnomes, which drains player stasis when the player is near and spends battery/heat with nothing targeted. Consider keeping the tone off when there is no target in AUTO.
turret.js: an auto_switch event is logged on the first active frame, and again on every laser <-> acoustic flip during cooldown cycles. That is fine, but flips are frequent when the target thrashes.
The ring/label CSS transition is 300ms. At ~1.5fps in headless, the locked ring can still read cyan for one frame; not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted sessions TEST_auto_turret / TEST_auto_close / TEST_auto_far. Rules restored to their original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with: cd /app/backend && pytest tests -n0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). Entities sit at lead + offset (clamped at 3m), so their distance to the turret stays roughly constant after deploy. To get targets 20-32m from the turret, set interval 20, press step-closer x4 (lead 20) and then deploy; for the 'close' reason, step x5 (lead 0) and then deploy. Detect open drawers with '[data-testid=hallway-panel].open' / '[data-testid=data-feed-panel].open'; the feed drawer covers record-stop-button. The toneHz slider: focus '[data-testid=slider-toneHz] [role=slider]', Home = 60, PageUp = +10. Read ring attributes in one page.evaluate call to avoid render races. Turret events can be checked by recording, stopping, then GET /api/sessions/{id}/jsonl (lines with k=='e'). Headless sim runs at ~0.15x, so the 3s deploy takes ~20s real.
